title_en: Good News (20/20): A City Brings Back a Lost River
note_en: 从 A 到 B ("from A to B") can span not only times and places but whole lists of things, summing up a range: 从深海里发现的奇特生物，到重新焕发生机的城市河流，这二十条新闻讲的其实是同一个故事 "From strange creatures found in the deep sea to a city river brought back to life, these twenty news stories are really telling the same story." Notice that 到 starts its own clause after a comma, and the main point comes only after the whole range.
